transcript: Your life is going to work out better than you think. The right things are still going to happen for you. The right people are still going to find you. And the wrong ones will slowly lose access to your life without you needing to chase, beg or explain. One day you will wake up in a home that feels peaceful, not just beautiful, peaceful. You will have mornings where your heart is not racing. You will have work that gives you purpose. You will have love that feels safe, not confusing. You will sit beside someone who does not make you question if you are enough. You will have slow Sundays, warm dinners, quiet holidays, and moments where you look around and whisper, I made it. You will travel to places you once only dreamed about. You will meet people who remind you that kindness still exists and you will become someone else's proof that life can change. So please, stop holding your breath like everything is about to fall apart. What is meant for you will not require you to destroy yourself to keep it. The life coming for you is softer than the life you survived. Everything is still unfolding. Everything is still moving. Everything is still working in ways you cannot see yet. Read these words when you wake up. Read them again before you sleep and slowly your heart will stop preparing for disaster and start preparing for peace.
